text:
also, this flow breaks it:

paint some model -> lift the brush -> wait several seconds -> switch to any other model -> paint carries over -> click paint tool -> model is now white -> go back to the one u started painting -> its white also now
resolution: Same root cause and fix as req_1488 (distinct repro: paint model A, switch to model B, B shows A's paint, then B goes white and A goes white too). All three symptoms were the one shared STUDIO_PAINT_KEY texture restored once per model per session. The per-model reload tracker (reload on model-identity change / async blob arrival, base-coat only truly-unpainted models, never clobber own/in-progress strokes, reset on unmount) fixes carry-over and white-out together. User-confirmed working.
